story.title: How Google helped destroy adoption of RSS feeds (2023)

draft:
I've been thinking about the demise of RSS feeds and how Google's actions contributed to their decline. 
Google Reader's shutdown in 2013 marked a significant blow to RSS adoption. 
The lack of a dominant RSS reader led to fragmentation, making it harder for users to discover and subscribe to feeds. 
What role do I think RSS could still play in content discovery today?
